zh-CN.title: 处理文字的三条原则
zh-CN.description: 两条线从重合到分开。直接看形状辨认变化，用日常语言说明差距，只有求具体数值时才引入计算。
labels: 两条曲线从哪里开始分开？
图优于文字
看形状，就能找到分开的位置，
也能看出之后的走势。
时间
从这里分开
差距
清晰优于复杂
图里的「差距」是什么意思？
在同一时刻，一条线比另一条线
高出多少，就是它们的差距。
直观优于形式
想知道变化方向，看图就能说：
两条线分开后，差距越来越大。
要算差多少时，再取同一时刻的两个值，
用较大的减去较小的。

en.title: Three principles for presenting information
en.description: Two lines coincide and then diverge. See the change, define the gap in everyday language, and turn to calculation when a number is needed.
labels: Where do the two curves begin to diverge?
Visuals over text
The shapes show where the lines
part and how the gap changes.
Time
Divergence
Gap
Clarity over complexity
What does “gap” mean here?
At the same moment, how much higher
is one line than the other? That difference
is the gap.
Intuition over formalism
To tell which way things are changing, look:
the gap grows after the lines part.
To find the size of the gap, take both values
at the same moment and subtract the smaller.
